2609.01560.title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
2609.01560.paper_summary: We present H3-World, an efficient framework that turns the 33B MiniMax-H3 video generator into an interactive world model. Our key finding is that, as large video generators become more capable, language is emerging as a natural interface for control. MiniMax-H3, for example, already supports zero-shot control of character behavior and camera motion through natural-language instructions. Building on this, H3-World turns this coarse language interface into precise, temporally grounded world control, without introducing dedicated action modules. Specifically, we represent each action as a structured combination of character and camera instructions, and align them with the corresponding temporal video latents. To make the control temporally precise, we further introduce temporal attention routing, which restricts each instruction to its intended time interval and reduces control leakage across actions. Importantly, H3-World directly reuses the semantic representations learned during large-scale video pretraining and requires only lightweight adaptation. With only 8,000 gameplay samples, 10,000 LoRA optimization steps, and 0.199% trainable parameters, H3-World achieves effective character and camera control while preserving strong generation quality. It also generalizes to unseen scenarios. These results show that the control capabilities emerging in large video generators can be efficiently transformed into interactive world control.
2609.01560.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 H3-World，一個高效的框架，將 33B MiniMax-H3 視頻生成器轉變為互動世界模型。我們的主要發現是，隨著大型視頻生成器變得越來越強大，語言正在成為控制的自然介面。例如，MiniMax-H3 已經支持通過自然語言指令進行角色行為和相機運動的零樣本控制。在此基礎上，H3-World 將這種粗略的語言介面轉變為精確的、時間基礎的世界控制，而不引入專用的動作模塊。具體而言，我們將每個動作表示為角色和相機指令的結構化組合，並將其與相應的時間視頻潛在變量對齊。為了使控制在時間上精確，我們進一步引入了時間注意力路由，這限制了每個指令在其預定的時間區間內，並減少了跨動作的控制泄漏。重要的是，H3-World 直接重用在大規模視頻預訓練期間學習的語義表示，並且只需要輕量級的適應。僅用 8,000 個遊戲樣本、10,000 次 LoRA 優化步驟和 0.199% 的可訓練參數，H3-World 就能實現有效的角色和相機控制，同時保持強大的生成質量。它還能夠推廣到未見的場景。這些結果表明，大型視頻生成器中出現的控制能力可以有效地轉化為互動世界控制。
